theme: An open day in Dubrovnik, before Saturday's boat.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — no meetings on the calendar. Spend the connected hours clearing charter prep before you board Saturday and lose signal.

needsAttention.title: Clear the charter prep
needsAttention.detail: Pre-book the Komolac→Cavtat transfer, confirm the hotel bag-hold and early Sept 20 checkout, and confirm your Nautilus boarding time and return transfer — all while you're on land, since you board Saturday and lose connectivity.

needsAttention.title: Send Kerrie the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: Kerrie Waring replied to your whistleblower document asking for the AI paper you referenced — a quick send while you have Dubrovnik wifi.

needsAttention.title: Lock Florida arrival logistics
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 Tampa SUV rental and the Sept 20–22 St Pete lodging gap are both overdue p1; settle now rather than mid-charter, and glance that the St Pete Airbnb flipped from pending to confirmed.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: The first real week of autumn calls for kabocha and chestnuts — a slow, technique-driven plate waiting for you back home once the charter's behind you.

acts.line: An open start in Dubrovnik, with the Old Port and a slow coffee before anything else.
The last reliable stretch of signal before the boat, worth spending on whatever needs the internet.
A calm last night ashore before Saturday's boarding.
